description: This header defines B-tree map and multimap container classes (`absl::btree_map` and `absl::btree_multimap`) that are optimized associative containers using B-trees, similar to `std::map` and `std::multimap`, with API and performance differences. It includes class templates, functions for swapping and erasing, and internal parameter structures.

classes.name: absl::btree_map
classes.description: A template class implementing an ordered associative container based on B-trees, supporting unique keys and various insertion, deletion, and lookup operations.

classes.name: absl::btree_multimap
classes.description: A template class implementing an ordered multimap container based on B-trees, allowing multiple elements with equivalent keys.

classes.name: container_internal::map_params
classes.description: A parameter structure holding type parameters for B-tree map and multimap, including key, data, comparator, allocator, target node size, and whether it is a multimap.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Function template to swap the contents of two B-tree map or multimap containers.

methods.name: erase_if
methods.description: Function template to erase elements satisfying a predicate from a B-tree map or multimap.
